description: KyberSwap Elastic's reinvestment-curve and tick-update logic reconciled liquidity at the active tick via two separate paths. Under a contrived swap-then-mint ordering near tick boundaries, the two paths desynchronized — the pool credited liquidity on one path that was never decremented on the other, letting the attacker repeatedly extract phantom liquidity. Multi-EVM (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Base) affected. The canonical mainnet exploit_tx here is the first of three back-to-back txs from primary exploiter 0x50275E0B… on 2023-11-22 22:55 UTC; vulnerable_contract is the KyberSwap Elastic Factory.
